routes.interpretation: Separate the definitional identity V=Db from the theorem-dependent statement that volume governs expressivity robustness.
routes.method: Pin Definitions 2.1-2.3 and enumerate every restriction in the paragraph following Theorem 4.2.
routes.result: The definition and quantifiers are source-verified. The robustness conclusion is conditional on Theorem 4.2.
routes.why_unresolved: Source transcription verifies what the authors define, not that the resulting expressivity characterization is mathematically true.
routes.negative_control: The checker rejects a claim contract that omits polynomial width or presents insufficient-volume models as characterized.

routes.interpretation: Test whether Db is an exact information-capacity threshold under the paper's actual fixed-point alphabet.
routes.method: Compute |F_b|=2(2^(2b)-1)+1 exactly and compare D-tuple capacity against the historical binary-cell proxy.
routes.source_basis: Appendix A.3 Definition A.1 and Definitions 2.1-2.3.
routes.result: The historical proxy is rejected: at N=8,b=1,D=2 it says volume 2<3 cannot encode positions, while the actual F_1 has 7 values and 7^2>=8 tuples.
routes.why_unresolved: This falsifies only the historical simplified proxy, not the asymptotic volume definition or the full expressivity theorem.
routes.negative_control: The old D*b>=ceil(log2 N) finite boundary is explicitly prevented from serving as full-claim evidence.

routes.interpretation: Ask whether prior padded-transformer results already establish width robustness at sufficient volume.
routes.method: Compare London–Kanade's log-width results with the arbitrary-width statement of Theorem 4.2.
routes.source_basis: London & Kanade, OpenReview eG5oh8l1WZ; current paper Theorem 4.1 and Theorem 4.2.
routes.command: orx lit "London Kanade 2025 padded transformers expressivity constant width TC0 AC0"
routes.result: The reference supplies specific width-regime endpoints, not the current paper's full volume-based robustness characterization.
routes.why_unresolved: Independent literature support is narrower than the scored claim.
routes.negative_control: A matching result at logarithmic width is not counted as evidence for every sufficient-volume width.

routes.interpretation: Seek two admissible families on the same precision side with sufficient volume but different widths and different recognized language classes.
routes.method: Audit the theorem domain, the known printed routing mismatch, actual F_b capacity, and the insufficient-volume discussion for an assumption-satisfying counterexample.
routes.source_basis: Definitions 2.1-2.3, Theorem 4.2, Section 6, and Appendix C.2.
routes.result: The finite proxy counterexample lies outside the theorem conclusion being tested, and the routing mismatch is repairable. No valid expressivity counterexample was established.
routes.why_unresolved: Capacity of positional codes is neither necessary nor sufficient by itself to separate language classes under all architecture assumptions.
routes.negative_control: The validator refuses to relabel a proxy mismatch or insufficient-volume example as theorem falsification.

unresolved_obligations: show that all admissible sufficient-volume width/precision allocations are covered
avoid substituting positional-code capacity for transformer expressivity
